popular.title: Popular Questions
popular.q1_question: What is the biggest festival in Cusco?
popular.q1_answer: Inti Raymi, the Festival of the Sun, is the largest and most famous theatrical reenactment of an ancient Inca ceremony.
popular.q2_question: Which month has the most festivals?
popular.q2_answer: June is a particularly busy month for festivals in Cusco, including the famous Inti Raymi and Corpus Christi.

quiz.title: Which festival is for me?
quiz.q1_question: I don't know where to start! Can you help?
quiz.q1_answer: Of course! Our Festival Finder quiz will ask you a few questions to give you personalized recommendations based on your interests.
quiz.q2_question: I'm looking for a deep spiritual experience.
quiz.q2_answer: We recommend Qoyllur Rit'i or the pilgrimage to the Lord of Huanca, both are powerful experiences of faith and devotion.

lunes-santo-temblores.description: Procession of the Lord of the Tremors, the 'Taitacha Temblores', sworn patron of Cusco.
lunes-santo-temblores.longDescription: Holy Monday is a day of immense devotion in Cusco. Thousands of faithful gather to accompany the procession of the Lord of the Tremors. The image, a Christ of mestizo features darkened by the smoke of candles, travels through the streets while devotees throw red ñuychu flowers. It is the most crowded moment of faith during Holy Week in Cusco.
lunes-santo-temblores.history: Story goes that in 1650, an earthquake devastated the city until the image of Christ was brought out in procession, stopping the tremors. Since then, he is the sacred protector of the city.

traditions.nyuychu_tradition: Rain of Ñuychu flowers: the sacred red flower that symbolizes blood and devotion.
traditions.blessing_tradition: Blessing at the Plaza de Armas: the peak moment where the Lord gives his blessing to the four cardinal points.
traditions.devotion_tradition: Change of robes: the Lord wears gold and silver embroidered robes donated by the faithful.

schedule.procession_desc: The sacred image leaves the Cathedral to tour the historical center, returning for the final blessing.

viernes-santo-regional.location_detail: Squares and homes throughout the Cusco region.
viernes-santo-regional.description: Day of fasting, reflection and the gastronomic tradition of the 12 dishes.
viernes-santo-regional.longDescription: Good Friday in Cusco combines religious solemnity with a unique family tradition: the consumption of the 12 dishes. During the morning, fasting and reflection are observed, and at noon, families gather to taste dishes that do not contain red meat, commemorating the Last Supper and the 12 apostles.
viernes-santo-regional.history: This tradition dates back to colonial times and symbolizes abundance and community sharing, respecting the abstinence from meat imposed by the church.

traditions.twelve_dishes_tradition: The 12 Dishes: soups like lizas or rice, fish dishes like cod, and desserts like mazamorra and rice pudding.
traditions.fasting_tradition: Morning fasting: many faithful abstain from eating until the time of the 12 dishes lunch.
traditions.regional_procession: Holy Sepulcher: Solemn processions in every district and province, notably in Chinchero and Cusco.

schedule.lunch_desc: Family lunch of the traditional 12 dishes.
schedule.evening_procession_desc: Holy Sepulcher processions in the main squares of the region.

lunes-santo-sepulcro-chinchero.description: Solemn procession of the Lord of the Holy Sepulcher in the historical town of Chinchero.
lunes-santo-sepulcro-chinchero.longDescription: In Chinchero, Holy Monday is experienced with particular solemnity. The procession of the Holy Sepulcher travels through the town's Inca squares, accompanied by the Varayocs and the community in an atmosphere of deep respect.
lunes-santo-sepulcro-chinchero.history: A tradition dating back centuries, where communal and religious authority unite to worship the passion of Christ.

traditions.solemn_procession: Tour through the four historical neighborhoods of Chinchero.
traditions.devotion_chinchero: Active participation of the Varayocs carrying the litters.

schedule.procession_desc: Solemn procession through the temple's atrium and main squares.

miercoles-santo-encuentro-chinchero.description: Ritual of the 'Encounter' between the images of the Virgin and Jesus.
miercoles-santo-encuentro-chinchero.longDescription: Holy Wednesday features the Encounter procession in Chinchero, a dramatic and moving representation of the meeting between the Virgin Mary and her son on the way to Calvary.

schedule.procession_desc: The images leave from opposite points to meet in the main square.

pascua-resurreccion.description: Easter Mass and celebration of joy for the resurrection of Christ.
pascua-resurreccion.longDescription: Holy Week culminates with the joy of the resurrection. In Cusco, masses are celebrated from early morning and the atmosphere of mourning turns into jubilee and popular celebration.

traditions.sunrise_mass: Sunrise Mass: Celebrated in the early hours of the morning to welcome the day of resurrection.
traditions.joy_celebration: Popular celebration with music and bells throughout the city.

schedule.sunrise_mass_desc: Solemn Easter mass at the Cathedral and temples.
